annotations.title: Attach an uploaded file to the release

description: Attach a file uploaded to a URL from studio_upload_prepare: a track is added to the release (optional title, position and price) and then processed by Bitsound in the background (status processing, then ready; check with studio_release_get), a cover becomes the release cover. Position is the track number, 1 is the first; without it the track goes to the end, if the number is taken the tracks from there move one down. Uploaded files that are not finished within 24 hours are deleted.

position.description: Track number on the release (1-60). Tracks only

priceEur.description: Price of the single track in EUR, default 1.00. Tracks only

title.description: Track title, default from the file name. Tracks only

name: studio_upload_finish
